```{r}

# Source figure options, packages, and main data prep.
source("./R/fig-opt-fun.R")
source("./R/packages.R")
source("./R/data-prep.R")
source("./R/helpers.R")

# Settings
refit.models <- FALSE

```



Fatty acids, including including EPA (C205n3) and DHA (226n3) where measured in whole blood. We will assess the effect of supplementation on group level fatty acid profiles. As preliminary models indicated heteroscedasticity of residuals, log-transformed and standardized data was used in modelling. This allows for the same weakly regularizing priors for all fatty acis ($\text{FA}$). 

The model was designed to estimate differences between treatments ($\text{TX}$) at post-treatment time-points (T2 and T4). The full model definition for each time point is:


$$
\begin{align}
y_{i[\text{FA}]} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(\mu_{i[\text{FA}]}, \sigma_{\text{FA}}) \\
\mu_{i[\text{FA}]} &= \alpha_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}} + \beta_{\text{FA}} \times \text{Pre}_i \\ 
\alpha_{\text{[FA, TX]}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 1) \\
\beta_{\text{FA}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(1, 1) \\
\sigma_{\text{FA}} &\sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1)\\
\end{align}
$$



```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive check for target-wise models of post-treatment fatty acid concentrations conditional on pre-treatment values. The model expects log-transformed standardized values and the priors suggest no difference between treatment groups and a proportional relationship between th pre-intervention values and post-intervention measurements."
#| label: fig-m2-priorpred


fat_dat <- AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4"), 
         participant %in% total_participants) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value")  |> 
  mutate(.by = fa, 
         value_std = log(value), 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std)) / sd(value_std)) |> 
  mutate(FA = dense_rank(fa), 
         TX = dense_rank(treat)) 
  
  
# Fatty acid summarise  
fat_sum <- fat_dat |> 
    summarise(.by = c(FA,fa), 
              m = mean(log(value)), 
              s = sd(log(value)))
  
  

# Check n 
fat_n <- fat_dat |> 
  distinct(time, treat, participant) |> 
  summarise(.by = c(time, treat), 
            n = n())

# Filter for complete case and prep data 

fat_dat2 <- fat_dat |> 
  select(participant, FA, TX, time, value_std) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = value_std) |> 
  filter(complete.cases(pick(T1:T4))) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "TI", 
               values_to = "y", 
               cols = T2:T4) |> 
  mutate(TI = dense_rank(TI), 
         P = dense_rank(participant))


d <- list(
  # Length of indices
  N    = nrow(fat_dat2), 
  N_FA = length(unique(fat_dat2$FA)),
  N_P  = length(unique(fat_dat2$P)),
  N_TX = length(unique(fat_dat2$TX)),
  N_TI = length(unique(fat_dat2$TI)),
  # Indicators 
  P = fat_dat2$P, 
  FA = fat_dat2$FA, 
  TX = fat_dat2$TX,
  TI = fat_dat2$TI,
  # Co-variate and outcome
  pre = fat_dat2$T1, 
  y = fat_dat2$y, 
  # Prior only flag
  prior_only = 1

)



# Compiling the model
m2 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m2.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m2.exe")


fit_wrap(m2, fit = "fit.m2", DATA = d)


draws.m2 <- fit.m2$draws(format = "df")


draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 

  
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
   
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA, TI, TX, pre), 
            m = mean(mu), 
            lwr = quantile(mu, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(mu, 0.95)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             color = TX, 
             fill = TX)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2, aes(color = NULL)) + 
  facet_grid(FA ~ TI)


```



```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Model performance metrics from Model 2."
#| label: fig-m2-modelperformance


d$prior_only <- 0

# Sample the posterior
fit_wrap(m2, fit = "fit.m2p", DATA = d)


# Model performance
sum.m2 <- fit.m2p$summary()

# Get (most) problematic parameters
vars <- sum.m2 |> 
  arrange(-rhat) |> 
   filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 3) |> 
  pull(variable)



p1 <- sum.m2 |> 
  filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable_type = variable) |> 
  separate(variable_type, into = c("variable_type", "index"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  
  mutate(highlight = if_else(variable %in% vars, variable, "")) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(ess_bulk, rhat, size = ess_tail, color = variable_type)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = highlight, 
                color = NULL, 
                size = NULL)) +
  
  labs(x = "(Bulk) effective sample size", 
       y = "R-hat", 
       color = "Parameter type", 
       size = "(Tail) effective sample size") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale)




draws.m2 <- fit.m2p$draws(format = "df")


p2  <- draws.m2 |> 
  select(.iteration, .chain, all_of(vars)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(.iteration, value, 
             color = as.factor(.chain))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Iteration", 
       color = "Chain", 
       y = "Parameter value")



p1 / p2


```


A first model uses only complete-cases. The prior predictive check confirms that the model expects eleven fatty acid, a positive relationship between pre-intervention values and post-treatment values, and no differences in treatments (@fig-m2-priorpred). Sampling from the posterior was non-problematic as R-hat values approached 1 and chains mixed and converged well (@fig-m2-modelperformance).

Posterior predictive checks showed satisfactory patterns between replicated data (y<sup>rep</sup>; thin lines, one per draw in @fig-m2-postpred) and observed data (thick lines in @fig-m2-postpred).


```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive check of Model 2."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m2-postpred
#| message: false
#| warning: false


# Posterior predictive check 
draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  filter(.iteration %in% sample(1:2000, 50)) |> 
  select(starts_with("y_rep"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("y_rep")) |> 
  
  mutate(FA = rep(d$FA, 50), 
         TI = rep(d$TI, 50), 
         TX = rep(d$TX, 50)) |> 
  
  inner_join(fat_sum) |> 

  ggplot(aes(x = value, 
             color = as.factor(TX),
             group = paste(.iteration, TX))) + 
  geom_line(stat = "density", alpha = 0.1) + 
  
  geom_line(data = data.frame(
    value = d$y, 
    FA = d$FA, 
    TI = d$TI, 
    TX = d$TX
  ) |>  inner_join(fat_sum), 
  aes(x = value, group = TX, color = as.factor(TX)), 
  stat = "density", 
  linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  facet_grid(fa ~ TI) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = "Treatment groups", 
       x = "Observed / Predicted values")
  

```

Treatment with N-3 fatty acids robustly increased serum levels of C205n3, C225n3 and C226n3 fatty acids compared to placebo (@fig-m2-meanpred and @fig-m2-contrast). Post-treatment values were lower in the N-3 group for C181c9, C183n6, C203n6 and C204n6 with high probability at both T2 and T4 (@fig-m2-contrast). 


```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Predictions of fatty acid concentration in response to treatment. Pre-intervention values are means per treatment group, post-intervention means are predicted from the model with 99% PI."
#| label: fig-m2-meanpred




pre_int_means <- fat_dat2 |> 
  filter(TI == 1) |> 
  summarise(.by = FA, 
            pre = mean(T1))


m2_sum <- draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 
  
  inner_join(pre_int_means) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre, 
         y_pred = rnorm(1, alpha + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarise(
    .by = c(FA, TI, TX), 
    Mu  = mean(mu), 
    lwr99 = quantile(mu, 0.005), 
    upr99 = quantile(mu, 0.995), 
    lwr50 = quantile(mu, 0.25), 
    upr50 = quantile(mu, 0.75),
    
    lwr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.05), 
    upr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.95) ) |> 
  
  # Back-transform all estimates
  pivot_longer(cols = Mu:upr_pred90, 
               names_to = "est", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  inner_join(fat_sum) |> 
  
  mutate(value_org = exp(value * s + m)) |> 
  
  select(FA:est, fa, value_org) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = est, 
              values_from = value_org) |> 
  
  mutate(time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega"), 
         treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 

  add_row(
    fat_dat |> 
      filter(time == "T1") |> 
      summarise(.by = c(time, treat, fa), 
                Mu = mean(value)) |> 
      mutate(TX = NA, 
             TI = NA,
             FA = NA, 
              treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) 
  ) 
  
  

## Plotting predictions with data  
AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(participant %in% fat_dat2$participant)  |> 

  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  
  
  ggplot(aes(time, value, color = treat, group = paste(participant, fa))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  
   ## Add model predictions

  geom_errorbar(data = m2_sum, 
                aes(time, Mu, 
                    ymin = lwr99, 
                    ymax = upr99, 
                    group = treat,
                    color = NULL), 
                width = 0.1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  

    geom_line(data = m2_sum, 
            aes(time, Mu, group = treat, color = NULL), 
            alpha = 1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  

    geom_point(data = m2_sum, 
             aes(time, Mu, fill = treat, group = NULL),
             color = "black",
             size = 3,
             alpha = 1,
             shape = 21, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +

  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) +
  
   facet_wrap(~ fa, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(y = "Fatty acid concentration (&mu;g ml<sup>-1</sup>)", 
       x = "Time point", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"),   
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 12), 
        legend.position = "inside", 
        legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.1))
```

```{r}
### Contrasts
draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 

    # Compute contrasts
    mutate(treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |> 
    select(.iteration:TI, treat, alpha) |> 
  
    pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
                values_from = alpha) |> 

  
        inner_join(fat_sum) |> 

    mutate(contrats = omega - ctrl,
           # Here we need to multiply with the standardization
           rel_contrast = exp(s * contrats), 
           time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4")) |>
    

    
    ggplot(aes(x = rel_contrast, 
               fill = time)) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ fa, scales = "free") +
    
    labs(x = "Fold-difference (N-3 vs. Placebo)", 
         y = "Posterior density", 
         fill = "Time-point") +
    theme_classic() + 
  
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.2), 
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             lty = 2, 
             color = "gray50") +


  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: m3-data-prep
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Preparing data for the imputation model

# Prepare data set with complete cases at baseline, imputation of missing values
# post-treatment.
fat_dat_compl <- AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4"), 
         participant %in% total_participants) |>
  
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>

  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value")  |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  
  # Two participants have no data at T1
  filter(!is.na(T1)) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "time", 
               values_to = "value", 
               cols = T1:T4) |> 
  mutate(.by = fa, 
         value_std = log(value), 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
           sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(FA = dense_rank(fa), 
         TX = dense_rank(treat)) 
  
  
# Fatty acid summarise on complete data 
fat_sum_compl <- fat_dat |> 
    summarise(.by = c(FA,fa), 
              m = mean(log(value), na.rm = TRUE), 
              s = sd(log(value), na.rm = TRUE))


# Check n 
fat_n_compl <- fat_dat |> 
  distinct(time, participant) |> 
  summarise(.by = c(time), 
            n = n()) |> 
  mutate(missing = 1 - n / max(n))

totaln_fa <-  round(fat_n_compl[1, 2][[1]], 0)
percent_miss_t2 <- round(100 * fat_n_compl[2, 3][[1]], 0)
percent_miss_t4 <- round(100 * fat_n_compl[3, 3][[1]], 0)

```


Extending the former model with missing data imputations allows us to estimate the effect of treatment of fatty acid profiles with intention-to-treat (ITT). Missing data imputation is done on post-treatment scores only with the total sample size being n = `r totaln_fa` with `r percent_miss_t2` and `r percent_miss_t4`% of participants missing at time points T2 and T4, respectively.

The imputation mechanism replaces missing values with parameters estimated from observed data (pre-treatment values and treatment allocation) though the likelihood. 

The imputation model thus is defined as:

$$
\begin{align}
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^\text{all} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(\mu_{i[\text{FA}]}, \sigma_{\text{FA}}) \\
\mu_{i[\text{FA}]} &= \alpha_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}} + \beta_{\text{FA}} \times \text{Pre}_i \\ 
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^{\text{all}} &= 
\begin{cases} 
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^{\text{obs}} & \text{if observed}  \\
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^{\text{mis}} & \text{if missing}
\end{cases} \\
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^{\text{mis}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0,2) \\
\alpha_{\text{[FA, TX]}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 1) \\
\beta_{\text{FA}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(1, 1) \\
\sigma_{\text{FA}} &\sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1)\\
\end{align}
$$

Prior predictive simulations confirm the general structure of the model (@fig-m3-prior). Model performance metrics from posterior sampling also indicates a functioning model (@fig-m3-performance).


```{r}
#| fig-width: 6

### Data imputation fatty acid profiles ###################

# Filter for complete case and prep data 
fat_dat_compl2 <- fat_dat_compl |> 
  select(participant, FA, TX, time, value_std) |>

  pivot_longer(names_to = "TI", 
               values_to = "y", 
               cols = T2:T4) |> 
  mutate(TI = dense_rank(TI), 
         P = dense_rank(participant), 
         # Add missing data and fill y
         obs = if_else(is.na(y), 0, 1), 
         y = if_else(is.na(y), -999, y) )




d <- list(
  # Length of indices
  N    = nrow(fat_dat_compl2), 
  N_FA = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$FA)),
  N_P  = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$P)),
  N_TX = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$TX)),
  N_TI = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$TI)),
  # Indicators 
  P = fat_dat_compl2$P, 
  FA = fat_dat_compl2$FA, 
  TX = fat_dat_compl2$TX,
  TI = fat_dat_compl2$TI,
  # Co-variate and outcome
  pre = fat_dat_compl2$T1, 
  y = fat_dat_compl2$y, 
  obs = fat_dat_compl2$obs,
  # Prior only flag
  prior_only = 1
)


# Compiling the model
m3 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m3.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m3.exe")


# Prior predictive check
fit_wrap(m3, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m3")

draws.m3 <- fit.m3$draws(format = "df")


draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 

  
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
   
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA, TI, TX, pre), 
            m = mean(mu), 
            lwr = quantile(mu, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(mu, 0.95)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             color = TX, 
             fill = TX)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2, aes(color = NULL)) + 
  facet_grid(FA ~ TI) + 
  labs(x = "Pre-inteverntion values", 
       y = "Prior predictive distribution of post-intervention values (std.)", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) 



```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Model performance metrics model 3."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m3-performance
#| message: false
#| warning: false



d$prior_only <- 0

# Sample from the posterior
fit_wrap(m3, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m3p")

# Diagnostics 
# fit.m3p$diagnostic_summary()

# Model performance
sum.m3 <- fit.m3p$summary(.cores = 12)





# Get (most) problematic parameters
vars <- sum.m3 |> 
    filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma", "y_imp"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  arrange(-rhat) |> 
  slice_head(n = 3) |> 
  pull(variable)



p1 <- sum.m3 |> 
  filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma", "y_imp"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable_type = variable) |> 
  separate(variable_type, into = c("variable_type", "index"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  
  mutate(highlight = if_else(variable %in% vars, variable, "")) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(ess_bulk, rhat, size = ess_tail, color = variable_type)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) + 
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = highlight, 
                color = NULL, 
               
                size = NULL), 
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  labs(x = "(Bulk) effective sample size", 
       y = "R-hat", 
       color = "Parameter type", 
       size = "(Tail) effective sample size") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  labs(title = "A")




draws.m3 <- fit.m3p$draws(format = "df")


p2  <- draws.m3 |> 
  select(.iteration, .chain, all_of(vars)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(.iteration, value, 
             color = as.factor(.chain))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Iteration", 
       color = "Chain", 
       y = "Parameter value") +
  labs(title = "B")



p1 / p2
```

The imputation model generally agreed with the complete-case analysis on the effect of treatment of serum fatty acid profiles (@fig-m3-predictions, @fig-m3-contrast, @fig-m3m2-predictions, and @fig-m2m3-comp).


```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: "Model predictions. Pre-intervention values are observed means, post-treatment (T2, T4) values are model predictions conditional pre-intervention value with 99% percentile intervals."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m3-predictions
#| message: false
#| warning: false


pre_int_means <- fat_dat_compl2 |> 
  filter(TI == 1) |> 
  summarise(.by = FA, 
            pre = mean(T1))


m3_sum <- draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 
  

  
  inner_join(pre_int_means) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  

  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre, 
         y_pred = rnorm(1, alpha + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarise(
    .by = c(FA, TI, TX), 
    Mu  = mean(mu), 
    lwr99 = quantile(mu, 0.005), 
    upr99 = quantile(mu, 0.995), 
    lwr50 = quantile(mu, 0.25), 
    upr50 = quantile(mu, 0.75),
    
    lwr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.05), 
    upr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.95) ) |> 
  
  # Back-transform all estimates
  pivot_longer(cols = Mu:upr_pred90, 
               names_to = "est", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 

  mutate(value_org = exp(value * s + m)) |> 
  
  select(FA:est, fa, value_org) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = est, 
              values_from = value_org) |> 
  
  mutate(time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega"), 
         treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  

  

  add_row(
    fat_dat_compl |> 
      filter(time == "T1") |> 
      summarise(.by = c(time, treat, fa), 
                Mu = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
      mutate(TX = NA, 
             TI = NA,
             FA = NA, 
              treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) 
  ) 
  

## Plotting predictions with data
```

```{r}
### Contrasts
draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 

    # Compute contrasts
    mutate(treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |> 
    select(.iteration:TI, treat, alpha) |> 
  
    pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
                values_from = alpha) |> 
    
     inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 

  
    mutate(contrats = omega - ctrl, 
           # Multiplying the standardizer to get the correct contrast (fold-diff)
           rel_contrast = exp(s * contrats), 
           time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4")) |>
    
 
    
    ggplot(aes(x = rel_contrast, 
               fill = time)) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ fa, scales = "free") +
    
    labs(x = "Fold-difference (N-3 vs. Placebo)", 
         y = "Posterior density", 
         fill = "Time-point") +
    theme_classic() + 
  
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.2), 
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             lty = 2, 
             color = "gray50") +


  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale)
```

### Model expansion: Heterogenous variance

Model `m3` does not enable treatment- and time-wise heterogenous variation. In model `m4` we therefore add $\sigma_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}} \sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1)$. 

```{r}

# Compiling the model
m4 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m4.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m4.exe")



d$prior_only <- 1

# Prior predictive check
fit_wrap(m4, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m4")

draws.m4 <- fit.m4$draws(format = "df")


draws.m4 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  inner_join(
    draws.m4 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 

  
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
   
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA, TI, TX, pre), 
            m = mean(mu), 
            lwr = quantile(mu, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(mu, 0.95)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             color = TX, 
             fill = TX)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2, aes(color = NULL)) + 
  facet_grid(FA ~ TI) + 
  labs(x = "Pre-inteverntion values", 
       y = "Prior predictive distribution of post-intervention values (std.)", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) 



```

```{r}

yreps3 <- fit.m3p$draws("y_rep", format = "df")



dat <- data.frame(
  FA = d$FA, 
  TX = d$TX, 
  TI = d$TI, 
  y = d$y,
  obs = as.character(1:d$N)
) |> 
  filter(y > -900) 
  
  
keep_obs <- dat |> 
  pull(obs)
  

sum_obs <- dat |> 
   summarise(.by = c(FA, TI), 
            s = sd(y)) 



bind_rows(
  yreps4 |>

  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("y_rep")) |> 
  mutate(obs = gsub("y_rep\\[|\\]", "", name)) |> 
  filter(obs %in% keep_obs) |> 
  inner_join(dat) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA,  TI, .draw), 
            s = sd(value)) |>
    mutate(model = "m4"), 
  
    yreps3 |>

  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("y_rep")) |> 
  mutate(obs = gsub("y_rep\\[|\\]", "", name)) |> 
  filter(obs %in% keep_obs) |> 
  inner_join(dat) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA,  TI, .draw), 
            s = sd(value)) |>
    mutate(model = "m3")) |> 
  
  mutate(TI = as.character(TI)) |> 

  
  ggplot(aes(s, color = TI, group = paste(TI, model))) +
  geom_line(stat = "density", 
            aes(linetype = model))  + 
  
  geom_vline(data = sum_obs, 
             aes(xintercept = s, 
                 color = as.character(TI))) +
  
  facet_wrap( ~ FA, 
             labeller = label_both) + 
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,1))
  








```

## Inference



```{r}



draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 

    # Compute contrasts
    mutate(treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |> 
    select(.iteration:TI, treat, alpha) |> 
  
    pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
                values_from = alpha) |> 
     inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 
    mutate(
      # Adjusted group means
      omega_adj = exp(s*omega + m), 
      ctrl_adj  = exp(s*ctrl + m),
      contrast_nat = omega_adj - ctrl_adj,
      contrats_log = omega - ctrl, 
      rel_contrast = exp(s * contrats_log),
      rel_contrast_nat = omega_adj/ctrl_adj,
      time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4")) |> 
  
  slice_head(n = 1000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(rel_contrast, rel_contrast_nat)) + geom_point()
  
  print()




```
